The Medicaid Planning Roadmap

I help families pay for Alzheimer's care and other forms of dementia without going broke. This is how: nine steps in three phases that take a family from a care crisis to approved benefits and protected assets, with the right professional at each step.

When each professional is involved

One family, one roadmap, five professionals who overlap. A solid bar is the step that professional leads; a light bar is where they stay involved. The care consultant starts first and never really leaves.
